name: Zsolt Varjú
summary: Software developer and platform operator. I build web applications end to end, design the data pipelines that feed them, and run the production infrastructure they depend on. At Serco I own and run a platform for the European Space Agency that delivers quality reports and data unavailability reports from Earth observation satellites, aggregating validated data from ESA, legacy and third-party missions, from choosing the approach to keeping it running in production. I use AI tools daily and build with them. Heading towards system architecture.

experience.title: Software Developer
bullets: Own and run, end to end, a platform for the European Space Agency that delivers quality reports and data unavailability reports from Earth observation satellites, aggregating validated data from ESA, legacy and third-party missions.
Choose the approach, technologies and architecture for new work, present it, build it, take it through UAT to production, and keep it running: monitoring, fixes, patches and backups.
Develop the frontend, the backend and the data ingestion pipelines, and maintain the automation scripts around them.
Operate the cloud servers: containers, CI/CD, updates, backups, access control and regular vulnerability remediation under formal change control.
Led a phased frontend quality programme: vendor bundle cut by roughly three quarters, JavaScript payload down a third, CSS down more than half, unnecessary re-renders reduced by 80%.
Work directly with the mission teams and IT on requirements, solution proposals, bug reports, change records and estimates.

experience.title: Quality Assurance Tester
bullets: Manual functional testing of web pages across browsers and devices, identifying and reporting defects.
Verified pages against graphic design specifications and fed detailed corrections back to designers and developers.
Maintained quality standards across a large portfolio of Slovak municipal and commercial websites.
Documented test results and corrective actions, working independently to fixed deadlines.

projects.title: Self-Hosted RAG Search
projects.line: Retrieval-augmented search over a local document collection: hybrid BM25 and vector retrieval, answers grounded in cited passages, and explicit abstention when no supporting evidence is found.
